subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add one-way A2A handoff as a sessions_send mode, a separate one-way primitive, or defer that semantic while only fixing narrower duplicate-delivery bugs?
rationale: The requested behavior is still missing, but it changes model-facing session-tool semantics and compatibility for existing A2A workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add Explicit Dispatch Mode
options.body: Extend sessions_send with a clearly named one-way mode, keep current conversation behavior as the default, and add docs/tests for both modes.

options.title: Create Separate Primitive
options.body: Add a sessions_deliver or sessions_enqueue style tool so one-way dispatch cannot be confused with conversational sessions_send.

options.title: Defer Dispatch Semantics
options.body: Keep the current conversation lifecycle and handle narrower duplicate-delivery bugs such as reverse-call and message-mirror fixes separately.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Dispatch Mode
recommendation.body: Extend sessions_send with a clearly named one-way mode, keep current conversation behavior as the default, and add docs/tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal for the sessions_send A2A lifecycle and its model-facing docs/API surface.
